data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that lets the user select a Google Font from a custom dropdown or screen.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FontPicker widget that can be used in a route or dialog to choose a Google Font and its variants. It allows searching, filtering by category or language, and returns a PickerFont object that can be converted directly into a TextStyle.
use_when: You need a UI for users to pick Google Fonts inside your application.
You want to allow users to customize font weights, styles, and categories at runtime.
avoid_when: You only need a static, predefined set of custom fonts packaged with your assets.
Your application cannot load fonts over the network from Google Fonts.
strengths: Supports filtering, search, and recent fonts.
Easily themed via FontPickerTheme or ThemeData extensions.
weaknesses: Requires internet access or device storage to download Google Fonts when they come into view.
Using too many fonts can impact performance.
